interpretation: Independent applicability pilot on fixed county topology. Same observed-only boundary GNN and one-sided memory/control adaptations. Not a Nikitin reproduction. No final-test, changing-topology, biological or state-of-the-art claim.
selection: minimum chronological validation MAE in raw case units

False.geometry: C=L with all county nodes persistent, no interior reduction
False.conductance: one per unique native undirected non-self neighbor link
False.self_loop_handling: native loops cancel in D-A; source GNN has its own self/residual update
False.features: one observed count per county, standardized by training-only scaler
False.coordinates: 52 uniform weekly holds on [0,1], final observed interval midpoint anchor
False.eigensystem_reuse: one fixed normalized L eigensystem shared across holds, bag and histories

True.geometry: C=L with all county nodes persistent, no interior reduction
True.conductance: one per unique native undirected non-self neighbor link
True.self_loop_handling: native loops cancel in D-A; source GNN has its own self/residual update
True.features: one observed count per county, standardized by training-only scaler
True.coordinates: 52 uniform weekly holds on [0,1], final observed interval midpoint anchor
True.eigensystem_reuse: one fixed normalized L eigensystem shared across holds, bag and histories

model_configuration.source_bank: independent boundary-response GNN; bounded learned query/reference signals
model_configuration.normalization: full-boundary mean diagonal per graph; exact zero response uses scale1
model_configuration.scan_preparation: batched decay/full factors/forcing projections; no per-hold bool validation
model_configuration.sorted_geometry_order_transfer: one CPU integer metadata transfer per forward
model_configuration.backward_scan: positive-duration reverse flow, never inverse flow
model_configuration.raw_parent_branch_feature: not applicable; geographic inputs have no branch feature
model_configuration.input_history: 52 observed graphs under frozen Chickenpox protocol
model_configuration.target: external following-week labels, outside observed historical domain
model_configuration.anchor: final observed interval midpoint, next-week target is external
